common_packet: TITMAS is closed-core/open-discovery-and-proof. It is not an Agent framework, general authorization platform, observability platform, AI firewall or certification authority. Monitor effect is NONE. Enforce needs customer-specific written scope, Human approval, rollback and emergency stop. Receipt is a technical evidence record, not truth, legality, safety or certification. Public proof does not prove adoption. Current blockers: one Critical security finding; China business entity and invoice capability unverified; pricing unapproved; Chinese counsel review incomplete; support/security owners unassigned; commercial routes not deployed; no customer, payment, production deployment, adoption or certification. Current paid Monitor availability is false.

entry_surface_packets.HUMAN_PRODUCT_BRIEF: Four product surfaces: Gate, Receipt, Audit, Health. Candidate offering: Monitor Pilot, one workflow, 1-3 Agents, up to 30 days, synthetic-first, no blocking or execution. No current price or availability.
